trigger: Player clicks a fake close button on a popup ad in Room 05.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: I clicked the tiny X to close the popup and it spawned three more drones!

lines.speaker: manya
lines.text: Fake close buttons are the lowest form of dark pattern design!

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Use CUT! Freeze the entire popup banner so we can smash through it!
